newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-PHILIPS RAISED AT LEHMAN.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-PHILIPS RAISED AT LEHMAN.

text.p: Philips Electronics NV was raised to "neutral" from "underperform" at Lehman Brothers, the investment bank said on Monday.

Analysts at Lehman raised their earnings per share estimate for 1997 to 8.96 guilders from 6.80 guilders and their 1998 estimate to 11.58 guilders from 9.30 guilders, and also upped their 12-month share price target to 205 guilders.

The upgrades came after Philips last week posted a sharp improvement in second-quarter earnings. However, Lehman noted that the stock had already risen 152 percent since January and said questions still surrounded its long-term strategy.
